TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_quality_risk: A false complete can union unpunctuated independent events, treat revoked/discontinued/exploratory/analyst-attributed assertions as actual direct facts, bind support or freight price to hardware, or call representation drift semantic evidence loss. Any such error corrupts residual-source, 4B/reranker, Evidence, S2 and later report decisions. R9 author gates passed 56 direct tests, 153 R8+R9 adjacent tests and 93 Project-OS/S1-foundation tests. TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Non-generative deterministic typed-frame and provenance compilation plus one local CUDA/FP16 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch. Embedding supplies ranking only; R9 semantic admission is deterministic. No 4B embedding, reranker, generation model, Provider, external capture or network call is authorized; later mixed-model and reranker eligibility is measured only on a real changed candidate pool.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation: Fail before consumption on disk, Git, exact parent/path, sync, predecessor/audit/R17 bundle, binding, runtime, input, collision, policy digest or public-schema drift. After exclusive receipt creation never retry the same attempt; persist raw execution immediately after the model returns and write only a redacted terminal failure receipt on later failure. Fail on anything other than five requests, one local batch, exact 96 and 16 unique ranks per request, or zero forbidden counters. Never truncate a target, complete transformation, partial diagnostic, route, privacy or integrity output.
